follow-up time: From 36-40 weeks gestation to 2-3 days postpartum
cohort: Nulliparous women at 36-40 weeks gestation and their partners
finding: Women's preference for cesarean delivery during pregnancy was significantly associated with actual cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women's preference for cesarean delivery increased postpartum, likely due to factors like fear of labor pain and perceived safety of cesarean.
